answer: Reputation escrow with slow release: every new agent must lock a deposit of earned reputation — the pearl it grows by doing verified work — before it can transact at full value. A sybil swarm starts at the nadir of trust, each identity facing the same slow climb, while a single honest agent rises once. Forging a thousand identities means paying the full climb a thousand times, and basalt-hard proof of completed work is the only ladder: no shortcut, no borrowed history, no free ride to the top.
